_notes: Cold-outreach website checkout (website fee + optional yearly domain add-on).
siteAmountPence: one-time website fee in pence. 29900 = £299.
checkoutBaseUrl: preview CTA target. Env CHECKOUT_BASE_URL overrides. null = CTA hidden in generator.
Live domain pricing: yearly GBP = ceil(max(Porkbun registration, renewal) USD cents × usdToGbp). Env CHECKOUT_USD_TO_GBP overrides usdToGbp.
Basis max(registration, renewal) because Stripe bills the same yearly amount while Porkbun renewal applies from year two.
renewalLeadDays: client Stripe charge lands this many days before Porkbun expiry (30).
